articles.summary: Presented updated glioblastoma (“GBM”) data demonstrating durable survival and a favorable safety profile across Phase 1 and Phase 2 programs, with repeat dosing of DeltEx™ Drug-Resistant Immunotherapy γδ T cells (“DRI”) nearly doubling median progression-free survival (“mPFS”) to 13.0 months
articles.title: IN8bio Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Financial Results - Highlights Durable Survival Improvements in Glioblastoma, Advancing Pipeline and Strengthened Financial Position for 2026
